title: Update 50 (U50) content migration and update schedule transition
description:
ESO Update 50 releases 2026-06-09 (tomorrow). The leaderboard/build data will reset and re-populate over the following week as players log new U50 trial runs. This issue tracks pausing current (U49) automated updates, then resuming with fresh U50 content once enough data exists.

Timeline:
- 2026-06-08 (today, later): Stop the regular hourly cron updates so U49 data is not re-scanned/overwritten during the transition window.
- 2026-06-09 (tomorrow): U50 goes live. Insufficient ranked log data initially — do NOT scan yet.
- ~2026-06-15 (in a week): Run a fresh scan to generate U50 build content (new u50 output directory + builds.json), verify, then re-enable the hourly cron to continue automated updates from U50 onward.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Hourly cron disabled before/around U50 launch (2026-06-08). 2. No automated U49 scans run during transition window. 3. Around 2026-06-15: fresh U50 scan generates output/u50 content with valid builds.json. 4. Deployment checks pass on U50 output. 5. Hourly cron re-enabled and confirmed running for U50.
notes: Cron schedule lives in .github/workflows/generate-builds.yml (currently re-enabled per commit 92116a6). Output versioning uses output/u49 today; U50 will need output/u50. See CLAUDE.md staggered schedule (14 trials, one per hour).

title: Log missing ability/gear icons during scan so they can be sourced
description:
The committed icon set (static/icons/, ~1667 files, no auto-download) goes stale when ESO renames or adds ability icons. When an icon referenced by a generated page is absent, the ability still renders (alt text shows the name), so it is not a blocking error — but there is currently no visibility into WHICH icons are missing. The tool should detect and log every missing icon filename during a scan/generation run so the missing files can be sourced and added manually.

Concrete example found during U50 testing: ESO Logs API returns abilityIcon 'ability_dragonknight_013_stonefist_b.png' for Stone Giant, but the icon set only had the older 'ability_dragonknight_013_b.png'. This 404s on the live site for ~19 U49 pages and went undetected.

Requirements:
- During page generation (page_generator) or icon resolution, check whether each referenced ability/gear icon exists in static/icons/.
- Collect missing icon filenames (deduplicated) and emit a clear summary at the end of the run, e.g. 'WARNING: N missing icons: <list>'. Optionally also write them to a file (e.g. output/<update>/missing_icons.txt) for easy hand-off.
- Must NOT fail the build — missing icons are non-blocking as long as the ability still renders with alt text.
- Include the ability/set display name alongside the filename in the log to make sourcing easier.
acceptance_criteria: 1. A scan run logs a deduplicated list of every referenced icon filename not present in static/icons/. 2. Each entry includes the icon filename and the associated ability/set name. 3. The run still completes successfully (missing icons are non-blocking). 4. Verified against U50 data: if the Stone Giant alias is removed, the run reports it as missing.
notes: Related: deployment_check.py already has icon-existence validation (lines ~271-290) but it is silently skipped on pages where its ability-slot selector finds 'No ability slots found' — so it does not currently catch these. Consider fixing that selector as part of, or alongside, this work. Icon source location: static/icons/ (copied to output/static/icons at build time). Parent context: U50 transition (eso-build-o-rama-lgr).

title: Update GitHub Actions to Node 24-compatible action versions
description: The Generate ESO Builds workflow (.github/workflows/generate-builds.yml) uses actions running on Node.js 20, which GitHub deprecates. Node 20 actions are forced to Node 24 by default starting June 16 2026, and Node 20 is removed from runners Sept 16 2026. Affected actions: actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-python@v4, actions/configure-pages@v4, actions/upload-artifact@v4, actions/deploy-pages@v4. Bump each to a version that supports Node 24 (e.g. checkout@v5, setup-python@v5, upload-artifact@v4 latest, configure-pages/deploy-pages latest) and verify a workflow run still succeeds.
design:
Node24-safe target versions (verified against GitHub release tags 2026-06-08):
- actions/checkout@v4 -> @v5  (v5+ runs node24; latest v6.0.3)
- actions/setup-python@v4 -> @v6  (CORRECTION: v5 is still node20; latest v6.2.0)
- actions/upload-artifact@v4 -> @v5  (CORRECTION: ALL v4 is node20; latest v7.0.1)
- actions/configure-pages@v4 -> @v6  (v6 is the node24 release)
- actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3 -> @v5  (MISSED IN ORIGINAL: composite action pinning a node20 upload-artifact; pairs with deploy-pages@v5)
- actions/deploy-pages@v4 -> @v5  (v5 is the node24 release)
setup-python@v6 and upload-artifact@v5+ require Actions Runner >= 2.327.1 (ubuntu-latest already satisfies this). python-version 3.9 remains supported by setup-python@v6.
acceptance_criteria: All 6 actions bumped to node24-safe versions; actionlint passes; a deploy_only run and a full trial run both complete with conclusion=success; live site integrity confirmed (deployment_check.py).
notes: Test strategy: workflow has no PR/push trigger and deploys to prod Pages, so no branch-safe CI. Graduated approach: (1) actionlint static check; (2) deploy_only=true dispatch exercises checkout+configure-pages+upload-pages-artifact+deploy-pages (always-run, near-zero blast radius, republishes committed output/); (3) normal trial dispatch (trial_id=1) exercises setup-python+upload-artifact (guarded by deploy_only != true), protected by existing download/validate/backup/restore steps. Verify with scripts/deployment_check.py + gh run view.
close_reason: All 6 actions on node24 (checkout@v5, setup-python@v6, upload-artifact@v7, configure-pages@v6, upload-pages-artifact@v5, deploy-pages@v5); deploy_only + full trial runs both green; no node20 deprecation warnings; live site 200. Also fixed latent invalid configure-pages static_site_generator:custom that v6 surfaced.
